Careers at nudge

# Real impact.  Brighter financial futures.

We help millions of people around the world make great financial decisions when it matters most. Help us build the next era of financial health.

[View open rolesarrow\_forward](https://careers.nudge-global.com/#open-roles) [Connect with us](https://careers.nudge-global.com/connect)

Who we are

## A platform, and a team, built for every financial decision

nudge brings employers one connected financial health platform that combines intelligent technology with human expertise. We work with some of the world's biggest brands, supporting every employee, decision, life stage and location. If you are ambitious, curious and want your work to count, you're in the right place.

84%of our team feel their work is meaningful

4.6Glassdoor rating

2.5 millionpeople worldwide making smarter money decisions with nudge

What we stand for

## Our values

We like to think we're a little different. Hopefully you are too.

diversity\_3

### We celebrate difference

We support people from every walk of life. Individuality makes our thinking sharper and our platform better. Being yourself here is a strength, not a slogan.

campaign

### We lead and we share

We go above and beyond, and we bring people with us. We are brave enough to stand out, and generous enough to pass on what we learn.

handshake

### We are in it together

We want the best for our people and our customers. Positive and energizing in the good times. Steady, supportive and refreshingly honest when things get hard.

school

### We are always learning

Curious, humble, never complacent. We learn from our wins, our mistakes and each other. To teach, you first have to learn.

Day to day

## What's working at nudge really like?

You'll instantly feel at home in a supported, focused, energetic environment. We'll give you the freedom to lead in your role, and move the business forward. And because we're driven by a shared vision – and love what we do – we have a real enthusiasm and unity of purpose that fuels the whole team.

![nudge team working together](https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/hero_picture_small-v6/image_uploads/b2b6429c-1062-44ed-870c-5ca33df730ab/original.jpeg)

What you get

## Perks and benefits

Support for the moments that matter — at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

payments

#### Bonus scheme

Your bonus is unlocked when we hit our growth targets but there's no upper limit!

pie\_chart

#### Share options

We are convinced that where our people own the company, our performance will reflect our shared desire for success so we offer a slice of the cake!

savings

#### Pension

nudge contributes 4% from your salary into your pension pot whilst you contribute a minimum of 5% into your pension pot

celebration

#### Regular social and team events

Once a quarter we celebrate our successes as a team

account\_balance

#### Interest free loan

To support your financial wellbeing we offer an interest free loan to employees that are affected by an unexpected financial burden

health\_and\_safety

#### Private Medical Insurance

You can enroll onto our private medical insurance plan

beach\_access

#### Time off

25 days annual leave excluding public holidays. 1 day off for your birthday, and a mid-year half day off which we call 'Q5'

insights

#### Financial education

Access to our nudge platform which provides financial education and coaches you to take action on your finances, improving your financial wellness

public

#### Worldwide working policy

We offer a wellbeing policy that allows you to work from anywhere in the world. A handy perk if you need a change of scenery or are looking to extend time abroad

self\_improvement

#### Wellbeing hour

Take one hour out of each working week to take care of your wellbeing. Whether it's time to talk, walk or relax - the choice is yours!

shield

#### Critical illness insurance

We offer this scheme to cover you by paying a proportion of your salary until state retirement age should you become diagnosed with a critical illness and declared "unfit" to perform in your role any longer

home\_work

#### Work from home allowance

We offer the flexibility to work from your home

family\_restroom

#### Life assurance

In the unfortunate event where you pass away whilst in our employment, the life assurance will pay out 4x your annual salary to your nominated next of kin

restaurant

#### Friday nunch club

Free lunch in the office on Fridays

sports\_tennis

#### Exercise clubs

Badminton and running clubs. You also have the opportunity to create clubs that everyone in nudge can benefit from and funded by the business

medical\_services

#### Medicash

Claim back on your essential healthcare expenses such as dental treatment, dental check ups, optical care, physiotherapy

menu\_book

#### Learning and development allowance

A personal learning and development allowance

groups

#### Women in tech membership

A global membership and coaching platform to help women build a successful career in the tech industry

smartphone

#### We will cover your phone bill

We cover the cost of your monthly phone bill (up to a maximum of £42.50). Alternatively, if you are in a client facing role, you can request a work phone.

[See our US perks and benefitsarrow\_forward](https://careers.nudge-global.com/locations/us)
